Specification: This module specifies a single-writer single-reader style cloud database interaction protocol generated from a PlusCal algorithm and translated to TLA+. A cloud process stores a sequence of values in a database and responds to client read requests according to a selected consistency model: Eventual, Consistent_Prefix, Session, Bounded_Staleness, or Strong; a client repeatedly reads, appends the observed value to its history, then writes back an incremented value. The model uses FIFO channels between the cloud and clients, assumes one client and a bounded number of operations, and defines state invariants characterizing the intended semantics of each supported consistency level.
IfThenElse: IF msg'[self].type="Write" THEN /\ Database' = [Database EXCEPT ![self] = Append(Database[self],msg'[self].dat)] /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "DW"] ELSE /\ IF msg'[self].type="Eventual" THEN /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "DE"] ELSE /\ IF msg'[self].type="Consistent_Prefix" THEN /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "DP"] ELSE /\ IF msg'[self].type="Session" THEN /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "DS"] ELSE /\ IF msg'[self].type="Bounded_Staleness" THEN /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "DB"] ELSE /\ IF msg'[self].type="Strong" THEN /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "DG"] ELSE /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "D"] /\ UNCHANGED Database

IF op[self]<MaxNumOp THEN /\ chan' = [chan EXCEPT ![Cloud] = Append(chan[Cloud], ([type |-> Consistency, ses|->ses[self], orig |-> self]))] /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "CRA"] ELSE /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "Done"] /\ chan' = chan
